intro: A fellow Skyborne sees promise in your druidic arts and points you toward Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. He can teach you how to reach the Cenarion Circle’s stronghold in Moonglade.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, young skyborne. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade.
You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you.
As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.
